scripts.firefox: npx --yes web-ext run --source-dir . --ignore-files test playground design docs scripts safari package.json README.md --start-url https://www.youtube.com
scripts.firefox:lint: npx --yes web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files test playground design docs scripts safari package.json README.md
scripts.firefox:build: npx --yes web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files test playground design docs scripts safari package.json README.md
scripts.safari:xcode: npm run safari:build && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location safari --app-name "Stable Captions" --bundle-identifier fun.thien.stablecaptions --macos-only --no-open && node scripts/xcode-setup.js
